tip.title: Start your morning with 300 ml of water

tips.tip: Drinking a glass of water right after waking up helps rehydrate your body and kickstarts focus before your first meal or workout.
Aim to add 1 to 2 extra reps or a small amount of weight every week on compound exercises while keeping clean form.

tip.title: Hit your daily protein target evenly

tips.tip: Spreading protein across 3 to 4 meals (25 to 35g per meal) supports muscle repair better than eating all of it at dinner.

tip.title: Rest days are when muscles grow

tips.tip: Your workouts provide the stimulus, but actual tissue recovery happens during 7 to 8 hours of quality sleep and active rest days.

tip.title: A 15-minute walk after meals helps digestion

tips.tip: Light walking after lunch or dinner adds easy steps to your daily total and keeps energy levels steady throughout the afternoon.

tip.title: Log meals as you eat them

tips.tip: Recording food right away takes 20 seconds and is much more accurate than trying to remember everything at night.
